credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Graphite sketch of a young girl, one of the artist's sisters. The girl is seated on a flat surface, with her hands placed in her lap. She is positioned in the center of the page, her head and body are facing slightly towards the left of the page. The girl is wearing a dress and has jaw-length hair, her expression is serious. The negative space that surrounds the figure on the left side of the page is heavily shaded, the negative space that surrounds the figure on the right side of the page is lightly shaded.
title: Untitled (Claudia O'Keeffe)
